method: In-process NodeIo emit calls only; inputs, schemas, metadata, and bounded preallocated lossless queues are prepared before timing. Each raw duration is retained in execution order. After timing, every full envelope is checked for payload, ports, generation, revision, sequence, sensitivity, and remote metadata by value and exact serialized bytes. Per-sink stream hashes and one representative envelope retain the correctness oracle compactly. No sorting or percentile aggregation is performed.
